after: Tapping a locked official stage card or the locked next-level button only opens an entry dialog that tells the player it needs 1 golden block to unlock and shows the fee; it does not unlock or enter until confirmed, and the same tap gesture cannot confirm. With no golden blocks the dialog stays open, shows toast 金方块不足, and marks the golden-block row as deficient; with sufficient blocks confirmation unlocks the stage, spends 1 golden block, and enters it.
